title: Quietly Jammy Mediterranean Lamb Tagine
description: A low-fat, Mediterranean dish featuring lamb, kinako, and nuka-pickle, cooked in a traditional clay tajine vessel, resulting in a jammy and glassy-jelly texture perfect for midnight cravings.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the clay tajine vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the kinako, nuka-pickle, dried apricots, chicken broth, salt, and black pepper, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours.
Remove the tajine from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Serve the lamb and sauce hot, garnished with additional chopped nuka-pickle if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
